channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Russia backs India’s candidature for UNSC permanent seat
item.description: “We are in favour of broadening the representation of Asia, Africa, and Latin America. We support Brazil's and India's candidatures for a permanent seat, and at the same time, I wish to emphasise this: we must satisfy the interests of the African continent,” Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said. Russia backs India’s candidature for UNSC permanent seat.

item.title: Russia's top diplomat rejects German calls to ease off its 'dangerous' escalation toward it
item.description: Does Berlin understand what this could lead to? Didn't they not learn the lessons of World War II? Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov asked in his speech at the UN General Assembly's annual gathering of world leaders Russia's top diplomat rejects German calls to ease off its 'dangerous' escalation toward it.

item.title: US challenges China on secret nuclear tests as arms race looms
item.description: A mounting standoff over allegations of covert Chinese nuclear testing and rapid arsenal expansion has collided with an intensifying domestic debate within the US over whether it must abandon its decades-long test moratorium. item.title: Relentless rainfall triggers floods, landslips across Nepal
item.description: In Rupandehi district, a part of Lumbini province, floodwaters from the Tinau River swept away six houses along the riverbank in Butwal on Saturday night as the river rose above its danger level, the Kathmandu Post newspaper reported. Relentless rainfall triggers floods, landslips across Nepal.

item.title: Cardiff City footballer Perry Ng receives Singapore citizenship, awaits FIFA clearance to represent
item.description: "Singapore has always been part of my family’s story, and over the years, it has become home to me too. I’m grateful for everyone who has supported me on this journey," says the 30-year-old defender. Cardiff City footballer Perry Ng receives Singapore citizenship, awaits FIFA clearance to represent.

item.title: Iran insists on diplomatic solution after Trump rejects peace plan
item.description: "They want to make a deal where they open the Strait immediately because they're losing so badly. They want to make a deal and I think that's fine. I like making a deal too," the U. S. President said. Trump rejects Iran proposal for deal to reopen Hormuz. Iran insists on diplomatic solution after Trump rejects peace plan.

item.title: Ireland players agree to play Israel fixtures, plan black armbands
item.description: David Courell, the CEO of the Football Association of Ireland, said at a long-delayed press conference earlier that an unnamed player's “discomfort with fulfilling this fixture” had caused deliberations for the rest of the squad Ireland players agree to play Israel fixtures, plan black armbands.

item.title: Iran suggests deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days; Trump rejects proposal
item.description: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, who detailed the proposal in a private gathering on September 24 on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, suggested that a speedy agreement would help U. S. President Trump ahead of November’s midterm elections Iran suggests deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days; Trump rejects proposal.

item.title: US strikes on Ecuadorian fishing boats raise humanitarian concerns but Trump admin not wavering
item.description: Attorney says fishers ‘losing their livelihoods’, but Marco Rubio maintains US still willing to ‘blow up ships if need be’While the US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, was being decorated in Quito by Ecuador’s president for “helping to promote peace in the region”, 10 Ecuadorian fishers whose boat had been blown up by US forces were adrift in the eastern Pacific.

item.title: Canada urges stronger partnerships as global order faces ‘rupture’
item.description: Canada’s Foreign Minister Anita Anand warned the UN General Assembly on Saturday that the international order has entered an era of profound disruption, calling for stronger multilateral cooperation and new partnerships as major powers increasingly turn away from global economic integration. Canada urges stronger partnerships as global order faces ‘rupture’.

item.title: Saudi Arabia warns Gulf security inseparable from global stability amid regional tensions
item.description: Saudi Arabia’s Foreign Minister warned on Saturday that escalating threats across the Middle East risked international peace, energy security and global trade, calling for stronger international cooperation to protect Gulf States and vital shipping routes. Saudi Arabia warns Gulf security inseparable from global stability amid regional tensions.

item.title: Cuba warns against ‘law of the jungle’ as Foreign Minister denounces US pressure
item.description: Cuba’s Foreign Minister warned the UN General Assembly on Saturday that escalating military and economic pressure in Latin America and the Caribbean was threatening international law, while accusing the United States of intensifying a decades-long campaign to isolate and weaken his country. Cuba warns against ‘law of the jungle’ as Foreign Minister denounces US pressure.

item.title: Lavrov issues call for new Eurasian ‘security architecture’
item.description: Russia's Foreign Minister, Sergey Lavrov, accused Western countries of destabilising the world through “force and double standards” in his address to the UN General Assembly on Saturday, vowing that Moscow's “special military operation” in Ukraine would be “carried through to the end.” Lavrov issues call for new Eurasian ‘security architecture’.

item.title: Countries adopt global blueprint to tackle fast-evolving crime in digital age
item.description: Countries adopted on Saturday a new global blueprint for tackling rapidly evolving forms of crime on Saturday, as the UN’s largest gathering on crime prevention and criminal justice opened in Abu Dhabi with a call for stronger international cooperation. Countries adopt global blueprint to tackle fast-evolving crime in digital age. Countries adopted on Saturday a new global blueprint for tackling rapidly evolving forms of crime, as the UN’s largest gathering on crime prevention and criminal justice opened in Abu Dhabi with a call for stronger international cooperation.

item.title: UN General Assembly debate Day 4
item.description: Small island leaders at the United Nations General Assembly on 26 September demanded climate justice, stronger ocean protection and increased solidarity. They warned that rising seas are already reshaping national borders and that distant conflicts are producing tangible impacts on their coasts. From the Caribbean to the Pacific, leaders from small island States demanded climate justice, ocean protection and greater solidarity at the UN General Assembly on Friday.

item.title: Poland Offers Financial Incentives To US As Talks On Military Base Advance, Minister Tells RFE/RL
item.description: Poland is offering to pay $15,000 a year for every US soldier stationed on its territory and cover infrastructure costs as Warsaw and Washington move closer to agreeing on establishing a permanent American military base. Poland Offers Financial Incentives To US As Talks On Military Base Advance, Minister Tells RFE/RL.

item.title: Michigan CEO loses job after posting AI-made image of her family in ‘Lake America’ sweaters
item.description: Jane Smith reportedly used ChatGPT to edit photo to show name Trump ordered US agencies to use for Lake Ontario amid trade war with CanadaThe CEO of a Michigan credit union is no longer employed there, according to the organization, after she posted on social media what appeared to be an AI-generated image of her and her family wearing sweaters emblazoned with the Donald Trump-associated words “La.

item.title: Ukrainian Soldiers Brave Russian Drones On Trek To Frontline Settlements
item.description: Ukrainian troops trek nearly 20 kilometers to reach Bilozerske in the embattled Donetsk region. Russian drone and aerial attacks have laid waste to the city that used to house 15,000 inhabitants. Speaking with RFE/RL, one soldier said that "everything is bad" near Dobropillia. Ukrainian Soldiers Brave Russian Drones On Trek To Frontline Settlements.

item.title: Pomp over progress in Xi’s US summit with Trump is a win for China
item.description: While the US president hailed the visit as ‘great’, almost nothing of substance was achieved, which was a win for XiKey takeaways from the Trump-Xi summit in WashingtonIf the Beijing meeting between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping in May was the “stalemate summit”, the second round of talks between the presidents of the US and China this week seemed to give up entirely on the idea of breakthroughs.
